item.title: Show HN: TrnRT – An open-source LLM inference engine for AWS Trainium
item.description: Hi HN, Sanchit here from RunAnywhere (YC W26). We just open-sourced TrnRT: Trainium RunTime, our inference engine for AWS Trainium. We started 3 weeks back, and currently we’re able to serve and run GLM 5.3 flash (FP8) on AWS trn2.48xlar | why kept: model, agent, runs, inference
